name: ProvenMetal

team.summary: Will & Johnny, founders from YC S26, building ProvenMetal.

product.summary: Front-of-house automation platform and plugins for KiCAD and Altium that coordinate component procurement, bare board fabrication, and assembly to deliver circuit boards in 5-7 days.

market.summary: Hardware engineers, drone and defense teams, and electronics developers needing domestic PCB supply chains and rapid turnaround times.

risks.risk: Intense competition from established players (e.g., Macrofab, Sierra Circuits, JLCPCB) and cheap overseas manufacturing.
Capital-intensive nature and low profit margins of hardware and manufacturing supply chains.

founder_depth.why: Founders are technical and shipping product, but prior domain depth or exits are not stated in sources.

shipping_evidence.why: Live product with public KiCAD and Altium plugins on GitHub and active paying orders.

demand_signal.why: Strong HN engagement with 237 points, 156 comments, and $70k across 11 orders in 6 weeks.

defensibility.why: Thin workflow wrapper over existing third-party fabricators and assembly houses with many named competitors.

analysis.thesis_fit_reason: ProvenMetal is a manufacturing supply chain and brokerage service for physical circuit boards, which is a physical product and service layer over physical work rather than an AI infrastructure or engineering software tool.
analysis.case_summary: Strong initial traction and public software integrations, against the core risk of competing in a commoditized, capital-intensive physical manufacturing market.
would_change_my_mind: Pivoting the business model exclusively to a pure software dev tool or CAD extension rather than managing physical manufacturing operations.
Proving sustainable software margins without capital-intensive physical supply chain constraints.
data_gaps: Detailed background on founders' prior professional experience or exits.
Direct repository metrics (stars, forks) for the GitHub plugins.
